title: Graded Identities of the Virasoro Algebra
summary: We study the graded polynomial identities satisfied by the Virasoro algebra over an infinite field, completing the analysis realised by C. Fidelis, D. Diniz, and P. Koshlukov [Z-graded identities of the Virasoro Algebra, Journal of Algebra 640 (2024), 401-431].
